title: 高一短对话：相机与舞蹈课
instruction: 听五段独立短对话，每段对应一道题，从A、B、C中选最佳答案。每条音轨内对话一遍，末尾留10秒作答与读下一题。此为完整五题第一节，不截六题；本机可重播只用于审阅，非正式考试次数控制。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Could I borrow your camera for the harbour trip on Friday?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Of course. It has been in the cupboard for months, though. Plug it in tonight, or you may find the battery empty when you get there.

questions.stem: What does the woman suggest the man do?
options: Change the date of the trip.
questions.rationale: B由Plug it in tonight与empty battery支持；A她同意借出，无须买；C没有建议改出行日期。

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Does your dance class start at ten past three every day?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: From Monday to Thursday, yes. On Friday it begins twenty minutes earlier because our teacher has to catch a train.

questions.stem: When does the dance class start on Friday?
questions.rationale: 3:10提前20分钟为2:50；B是周一至周四常规时间；C把提前当推迟。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I like this jacket, but the sleeves are rather short. Could I try a larger size?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Certainly. The fitting room is behind you. I will bring the next size in blue and grey.

questions.rationale: 试穿尺码、袖长和fitting room共同定位服装店；A酒店和B车站不能解释服装试穿情境。

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Will this hurt? I have never had a tooth taken out before.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: You may feel some pressure, but the area is numb now. Keep your head still and raise your hand if you need me to stop.

questions.stem: What is the man most likely to be?
questions.rationale: 拔牙、局部numb与停止治疗手势共同支持牙医；A无运动，C无烹饪。录音场景虚构，不作医疗建议。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I am sorry. The last two tickets for tonight were sold a few minutes ago.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Oh, what a pity. My brother is only here for one evening, and I had been looking forward to taking him to the show.

questions.rationale: 期待带哥哥看演出却无票、what a pity表失望；A高兴相反，B冷漠与期待矛盾。
